request.description:
Generated from cURL: curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/v1/generate-image/by-name \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat TOKEN)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"photo_id\":\"$(cat PHOTO_ID)\",\"haircut_name\":\"undercut\"}"
